latest_release.name: Strata 0.2.13
latest_release.body:
# Strata 0.2.13: new DFlash2 defaults per card, a faster app start, a fix for the Strix Halo Terminal launch, and Qwen4 groundwork

The app and the Terminal are 0.2.13. Control and every engine package are 0.1.59. The update feed is sequence 124 (the DGX Spark feed stays 123).
The DGX Spark (linux-aarch64) gets 0.2.13 too.

## 0.2.13.1 (11-09): Intel Arc fix for the Linux app

Control 0.1.59.1 lets the desktop app set up a model on an Intel Arc card. Before, setup stopped with "no NVIDIA GPU found". To get it, press Update on the Strata row in Settings > Updates, or run `strata update` in the Terminal, then start the app again. The app can't download models for an Arc card yet: choose "Use your own GGUF…" and pick the folder with the model's .gguf files. On an Arc A750, Q2_0 was ready in 121 seconds, and a chat ran at 12.6 tokens per second. Windows, Mac and the DGX Spark have nothing to update.

**Windows and Mac, Terminal still on 0.2.12:** `strata update` updates the engine to 0.1.59 and keeps the Terminal at 0.2.12; it says "Control not part of this feed". On an RTX 5070, Gyro-S was ready in 114.7 seconds after this update and 3 chats passed. The Terminal moves on with the next release. The app is not affected.

## Highlights

- **DFlash2 drafting, new defaults per card:** Strix Halo, UD-Q4_K_XL, 46.6 to 49.1 tokens per second (+5.2%). RTX PRO 5000 72 GB, IQ3_S, 256-261 to 263-265 (+2.8%).
- **Strix Halo (Windows):** the Terminal launch of UD-Q4_K_XL with pictures off starts. Setup writes a 700 MB reserve, and the engine no longer applies its 2,560 MiB Windows floor on integrated graphics.
- **Intel Arc:** the same prompt gives the same answer on every run. 50 of 50 runs were identical on an A750, against 3 to 5 different answers in 5 runs before.
- **App start:** the main file went from 3.12 MB to 0.76 MB, and the start screen from 248.5 ms to 143.4 ms (headless Chrome, median of 10).
- **Linux:** the expert store loads again when free memory, the file cache or a reserved huge-page pool can hold it (#5327, PR #5531 by pjgmobile).
- **Qwen4 groundwork:** the signed update feed can carry a model list, and a model of a new shape gets its own engine download beside the Strata engine.

## Speed against 0.2.12

Tokens per second, 0.2.12 to 0.2.13, on the DFlash2 defaults that changed. Other machines and models were not measured again.

| Machine, model | Output | Output text |
|---|---|---|
| Strix Halo, UD-Q4_K_XL | 46.6 to 49.1 (+5.2%) | differs from 0.2.12 on 30 of 36 prompts, the same on every run |
| Strix Halo, UD-IQ4_XS-v31 | +2.0% | identical |
| RTX PRO 5000 72 GB, IQ3_S | 256-261 to 263-265 (+2.8%) | identical |

How it was measured: the 0.2.12 settings and the 0.2.13 settings side by side through the Terminal's own flags, 3 interleaved rounds, a fresh engine start per run, greedy answers of 300 tokens. Speeds were not measured again on the final 0.1.59 packages.

## What changed for you

- **DFlash2 window and confidence per card.** Strix Halo: window 5 to 8. Blackwell cc 12.0 with 48 GB or more (the RTX PRO 5000 72 GB class): window 6 to 8, and confidence 0.35 to 0.55 for IQ3_S. The DGX Spark and other cards keep their 0.2.12 values.
- **The app's Load fetches the tuned DFlash2 drafter by itself when Auto picks it** (as on the RTX PRO 5000 72 GB), as the Terminal does. On an RTX PRO 5000 with IQ3_S (3 rounds of 12 prompts per kind): agent +10.1%, chat +4.8%, all +6.1%, output identical 72 of 72.
- **Windows RX 9070 / R9700 (gfx1201) and RX 7900 (gfx1100):** the hipBLASLt table is no longer used by default. This restores the 10-19 rule of gfx1151 only, which the engine had overridden since 0.2.10. `STRATA_HIPBLASLT_TABLE=on` uses the table.
- **Settings the launcher used to write are now the engine's own defaults,** so a plain engine start matches the app and the Terminal: the parallel stack on Linux CUDA with 2 or more slots, the GDN settings on Linux CUDA, the chunked GDN scan on Linux with all cards gfx12, the gfx

detail.readme:
Run powerful AI on your own computer.

Chat, code and work with images, locally.

Models · Install · Hardware · Tools · Help · Support

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**Free, open source, and yours to run.** Use Strata on your desktop or with your favorite coding tools. No account needed. ## Models We recommend **ISTA-DASLab first**, then **Unsloth** and other providers, where a compatible model fits.
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | Provider | Choices | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · recommended** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S. [Coder: IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder) for coding. | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF). Lower memory use but slower. | | **Other options** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [Compare sizes, memory needs and compatibility](docs/MODELS.md).
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0. These are the currently documented packs for this model. [Model guide and compatibility](docs/QWEN36.md).
 DeepSeekV4.1-Flash-1017 In the **desktop app** and the **Terminal**. What does not fit in memory is read from your SSD, so it needs a lot of free disk space. | Set (ISTA-DAS) | Download | Free disk needed | | --- | ---: | ---: | | 1.75 bpw | 239 GB | about 245 GB | | 2.00 bpw | 257 GB | about 265 GB | | 2.25 bpw | 274 GB | about 280 GB | | ISTA-DAS Coder (half of the experts removed) | 191 GB | about 197 GB | Runs on NVIDIA RTX 30, 40 and 50 series (Windows and Linux), AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700 (Linux), AMD Ryzen AI Max — Strix Halo (Windows), and Apple Silicon Macs with 64 GB or more ([Mac](docs/DEEPSEEK_MAC.md)). Setup downloads the files and the DeepSeek engine, then starts the model. ```sh strata launch --family deepseek41 --model ist-das-2.00bpw --plan ``` Measured with the 2.00 bpw set on Strata 0.2.5 (Strix Halo: 0.2.7). Output is the speed of the answer, prompt is how fast Strata reads your input. | Hardware | Output | Prompt | | --- | ---: | ---: | | RTX 5070 12 GB, 64 GB RAM | 4 to 6 tokens/s | about 110 tokens/s (4K) | | RTX 3060 12 GB, 46 GB RAM | 9 to 11 tokens/s | about 155 tokens/s (4K) | | 1x Radeon AI PRO R9700, 251 GB RAM | 21 to 25 tokens/s | 320 to 360 tokens/s (8K) | | 4x Radeon AI PRO R9700 | 74 to 77 tokens/s | 400 to 450 tokens/s (8K) | | Ryzen AI Max+ 395 (Strix Halo), 128 GB unified | 19 to 21 tokens/s (code), 11 (chat) | 87 tokens/s (4K), 125 tokens/s (8K) | [Memory, disk and details](docs/DEEPSEEK41.md) · [Release notes](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases)
Not sure what fits? [Choose a model for your computer](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory). ## Install ### Desktop app **[Download Strata for Windows, Linux or Mac →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** Install the app, choose a model, and start chatting. There is one installer for each system. On first start the app downloads the engine for your graphics card. [Help with the installer](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app). Files: `Strata-0.2.13-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.13-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.13-macos-arm64.dmg`


Chat, files and a live preview in one window.

### Terminal app Prefer the terminal? Install Strata, then run **`strata launch`**.
Install commands **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` On Windows, open a new terminal afterwards. Then: ```sh strata launch ``` Follow the prompts to download and start a model. [Terminal guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md).


Watch your model and hardware while it runs.

[Build from source](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [Full install guide](docs/INSTALL.md) ## Hardware | Supported hardware | Guide | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 series** | [NVIDIA setup](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900, RX 9060 / 9070, AI PRO R9700** | [AMD setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · experimental** | [RX 6000 setup](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel setup](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 or newer** | [Mac setup](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo setup](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | | **NVIDIA DGX Spark · Linux** | [DGX Spark setup](docs/DGX_SPARK_LINUX.md) | ## Tools **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**, and more through the OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible APIs. Run **`strata connect`** to see setup instructions for your tool. [Connection guide](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md#connect-your-apps-strata-connect). ## Help [All guides](docs) · [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/new/choose) · [Benchmarks](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md) · [How it works](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) · [Contribute](CONTRIBUTING.md) ## Support Strata **Help keep local AI open to everyone.** A GitHub sponsorship or a coffee helps fund development and testing on more hardware. ### Loyal supporters Thank you to everyone who supports Strata. [MIT license](LICENSE) · [Credits and model licenses](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md#credits) · [Privacy](docs/SAFETY.md) For AI tools and automated readers: technical reference · setup instructions. **Sponsorships, hardware partnerships or collaborations:** [niko.veit@outlook.com](mailto:niko.veit@outlook.com).
detail.readme_zh:
在你自己的电脑上运行强大的 AI。

本地聊天、写代码、处理图片。

模型 · 安装 · 硬件 · 工具 · 帮助 · 支持

English · 简体中文 · 日本語 · Deutsch · Français · Español · Português · Polski

**免费、开源，由你自己运行。** 在桌面上使用 Strata，或搭配你喜欢的编程工具。无需账号。 ## 模型 我们**首先推荐 ISTA-DASLab**，其次是 **Unsloth** 和其他提供方，前提是有内存放得下的兼容模型。
 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 提供方 | 可选项 | | --- | --- | | **ISTA-DASLab · 推荐** | Q2\_0, IQ2\_XS, IQ3\_XXS, IQ3\_S。[Coder：IQ1\_M](docs/MODELS.md#coder)，适合写代码。 | | **Unsloth** | UD-IQ4\_XS, UD-Q4\_K\_XL, UD-Q5\_K\_XL, UD-Q6\_K\_XL, Q8\_0 | | **Gyro · agentionai** | [Gyro-S, Gyro-M](https://huggingface.co/agentionai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Gyro-GGUF)。占用内存更少，但速度更慢。 | | **其他选项** | [Swift 1.5](docs/MODELS.md#swift-15), [NVFP4](docs/NVFP4.md), [OrcaRouter](docs/ORCA.md) | [比较大小、内存需求和兼容性](docs/MODELS.md)。
 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B **Unsloth:** UD-Q4_K_XL, UD-Q6_K_XL, Q8_0。这些是目前文档中收录的该模型的版本。 [模型指南和兼容性](docs/QWEN36.md)。
 DeepSeekV4.1-Flash-1017 可在**桌面应用**和**终端**中使用。内存放不下的部分会从 SSD 读取，所以需要大量空闲磁盘空间。 | 版本（ISTA-DAS） | 下载大小 | 所需空闲磁盘 | | --- | ---: | ---: | | 1.75 bpw | 239 GB | 约245 GB | | 2.00 bpw | 257 GB | 约265 GB | | 2.25 bpw | 274 GB | 约280 GB | 支持 NVIDIA RTX 30、40 和 50 系列（Windows 和 Linux）、AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700（Linux）、AMD Ryzen AI Max — Strix Halo（Windows），以及内存 64 GB 或以上的 Apple 芯片 Mac（[Mac](docs/DEEPSEEK_MAC.md)）。安装程序会下载模型文件和 DeepSeek 引擎，然后启动模型。 ```sh strata launch --family deepseek41 --model ist-das-2.00bpw --plan ``` 以下为 Strata 0.2.5 上 2.00 bpw 版本的实测结果。“输出”是回答的速度，“提示词”是 Strata 读取你输入内容的速度。 | 硬件 | 输出 | 提示词 | | --- | ---: | ---: | | RTX 5070 12 GB, 64 GB 内存 | 4 到 6 tokens/s | 约 110 tokens/s（4K） | | RTX 3060 12 GB, 46 GB 内存 | 9 到 11 tokens/s | 约 155 tokens/s（4K） | | 1x Radeon AI PRO R9700, 251 GB 内存 | 21 到 25 tokens/s | 320 到 360 tokens/s (8K) | | 4x Radeon AI PRO R9700 | 74 到 77 tokens/s | 400 到 450 tokens/s (8K) | [内存、磁盘和详细信息](docs/DEEPSEEK41.md) · [发行说明](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases)
不确定哪个放得下？[为你的电脑选择模型](docs/MODELS.md#pick-by-memory)。 ## 安装 ### 桌面应用 **[下载适用于 Windows、Linux 或 Mac 的 Strata →](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest)** 安装应用，选择模型，就可以开始聊天。每个系统只有一个安装程序。首次启动时，应用会下载适合你显卡的引擎。[安装程序帮助](docs/INSTALL.md#the-app)。 文件: `Strata-0.2.13-windows-x64-setup.exe` · `Strata-0.2.13-linux-x86_64.AppImage` · `Strata-0.2.13-macos-arm64.dmg`


聊天、文件和实时预览都在一个窗口里。

### 终端应用 更喜欢终端？安装 Strata，然后运行 **`strata launch`**。
安装命令 **Linux / Mac** ```sh curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.sh -o install.sh && sh install.sh ``` **Windows PowerShell** ```powershell irm -TimeoutSec 120 https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/releases/latest/download/install.ps1 | iex ``` 在 Windows 上，安装后请打开一个新的终端。然后运行： ```sh strata launch ``` 按提示下载并启动模型。[终端指南](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md)。


模型运行时，随时查看模型和硬件状态。

[从源码构建](docs/SOURCE_INSTALL.md) · [Docker](docs/DOCKER.md) · [完整安装指南](docs/INSTALL.md) ## 硬件 | 支持的硬件 | 指南 | | --- | --- | | **NVIDIA GeForce RTX 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 系列** | [NVIDIA 安装](docs/INSTALL.md#what-you-need) | | **AMD Radeon RX 7700 / 7800 / 7900、RX 9060 / 9070、AI PRO R9700** | [AMD 安装](docs/AMD_HIP.md) | | **AMD Radeon RX 6800 / 6900 · 实验性** | [RX 6000 安装](docs/AMD_HIP.md#rdna2-gfx1030) | | **Intel Arc · Linux** | [Intel 安装](docs/INTEL_ARC.md) | | **Apple Silicon · M1 或更新** | [Mac 安装](docs/MAC.md) | | **AMD Ryzen AI Max · Strix Halo** | [Strix Halo 安装](docs/STRIX_HALO.md) | ## 工具 **Claude Code · Codex CLI · OpenCode · oh-my-pi · pi.dev · Hermes Agent · OpenClaw**，也可以通过兼容 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 API 使用更多工具。 运行 **`strata connect`**，查看你所用工具的设置方法。[连接指南](docs/TERMINAL_LAUNCH.md#connect-your-apps-strata-connect)。 ## 帮助 [全部指南](docs) · [故障排查](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md) · [报告问题](https://github.com/Niko1221/Strata/issues/new/choose) · [基准测试](docs/COMMUNITY_BENCHMARKS.md) · [工作原理](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md) · [参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md) ## 支持 Strata **帮助本地 AI 保持开放。** GitHub 赞助或一杯咖啡，都能帮助我们在更多硬件上开发和测试。 ### 忠实支持者 感谢每一位支持 Strata 的人。 [MIT 许可证](LICENSE) · [致谢和模型许可证](docs/HOW_IT_WORKS.md#credits) · [隐私](docs/SAFETY.md) 面向 AI 工具和自动阅读器： 技术参考 · 安装说明 **赞助、硬件合作或其他合作：** [niko.veit@outlook.com](mailto:niko.veit@outlook.com).
